label: S2: board the hooded-bow cargo boat from the north bank, up its west bridge (X 200, 28 deg) onto its high deck (H 1.0)
why: its bank bridges at X 202 and 204 rise 40 and 37 deg, over the walker's 34 deg limit; the west one (rim piece 12) rises 28 deg. Its crew stand on the deck behind the rim (the seated man at 199.86, 15.76)
